name: a function type keeps its return union intact in the message
code:
declare function choose(s: string): "a" | "b";
export const pick: (s: string) => string = choose;

name: a record alias widening a literal-keyed table
code:
const messages = { state: { id: "state" } };
const byCode: Record<string, { id: string }> = messages;

name: a string index signature widens a known table
code:
const messages = { state: {} };
const byCode: { [key: string]: object } = messages;

name: a numeric index signature
code:
const rows = { 0: { id: 1 } };
const byIndex: Record<number, { id: number }> = rows;

name: the GroupRules indexed alias
named alias of an optional-key mapped type adds keys despite mutual assignability
code:
type Wide = Partial<Record<"known" | "extra", boolean>>; declare const source: { known?: boolean };
const alias: Wide = source;

name: property access with nested parentheses
code:
const container = { entry: { state: "ready" as const } };
const alias: { state: string } = ((container.entry));

name: literal value information is lost
code:
declare const source: "ready" | "done";
const alias: string = source;

name: unknown erases an otherwise known type
code:
declare const source: { known: boolean };
const alias: unknown = source;

name: imported named type and value
code:
import { source, type Wide } from "./source";
const alias: Wide = source;

files.source.ts: export type Wide = Partial<Record<"known" | "extra", boolean>>; export const source = { known: true };

name: equivalent named annotation
code: type Same = { known: boolean }; declare const source: Same; const alias: Same = source;

name: equivalent dictionary annotation
code: declare const source: Record<string, number>; const alias: Record<string, number> = source;

name: narrowing removes possible keys
code: declare const source: { known?: boolean; extra?: boolean }; const alias: { known?: boolean } = source;

name: dictionary narrows to optional keys
code: declare const source: Record<string, boolean>; const alias: { known?: boolean } = source;

name: fresh object declares its contract
code: const table: Record<string, number> = { known: 1 };

name: fresh literal declares its contract
code: const value: string = "ready";

name: call can be contextually typed
code: declare function make<T>(): T; const value: { known: boolean } = make();

name: mutable binding can receive more values
code: declare const source: "ready"; let value: string = source; value = "done";

name: var binding can receive more values
code: declare const source: "ready"; var value: string = source;

name: unresolved initializer is not evidence
code: const alias: Record<string, number> = missing;

name: unresolved annotation is not evidence
code: const source = { known: true }; const alias: Missing = source;

name: any initializer is not evidence
code: declare const source: any; const alias: Record<string, number> = source;

name: never initializer is not evidence
code: declare const source: never; const alias: string = source;

code: declare const source: string; const alias: number = source;

name: generic type parameter is unresolved
code: function example<T>(source: T) { const alias: unknown = source; return alias; }
